short: The Siegel–Weil product of local densities

lean.name: HeckeCharacterZeroLocus.SiegelWeilU.SiegelDensities
lean.plain: The Siegel–Weil product of local densities
lean.note: Fix a nonsingular Gram matrix for a frame with fewer vectors than half the dimension of the Hermitian space. Averaging the theta series for that Gram matrix gives the product of one archimedean density and the finite-place densities.
